local_eligibility.qualification_thresholds: These are bounded implementation choices; formal acceptance thresholds are unchanged

selection: Strictly lower per-SKU per-horizon MAE with identical complete declared cells selects the candidate; equality or underperformance retains the named baseline
uncertainty: Nonnegative integer bounds from the maximum measured absolute residual; empirical envelope only, no probability/confidence guarantee
authority: Current distinct proposal and approval permissions, exact immutable digests, current catalog pin, expiry, revocation and restore interlocks; no caller Boolean or model-confidence authority
privacy: Customer-free catalog business aggregates; subject export empty; explicit nested restore allowlists and all forecast review grants revoked without requiring tombstones
targeted_fault: Use a high model confidence value as sufficient evidence for a stronger forecast claim despite worse frozen error
